narration.text: Is AI taking your job? Today's news sparks big questions. Microsoft's latest layoffs are stoking fears of AI replacing jobs.
TechCrunch reports that Microsoft cut around 4,800 roles, 2.1% of its global workforce. These layoffs hit Xbox and commercial sales hardest. This fuels concerns about AI's impact on employment.

Next, a surprising reveal from Ars Technica. Anthropic, known for its anti-surveillance stance, stands accused of spying on users. A secret Claude tracker shocked users, though an engineer claims the "experiment" is over.
Good news for healthcare, as Wired-Gov reports the NHS is accelerating its AI rollout. This move aims to cut waiting times and improve care for millions. It is a major push for efficiency.
Finally, from Ars Technica, the UK regulator has issued a warning. They see an "arms race" to keep up with AI use in financial services. Millions are now using AI for personal finance decisions.
That's your AI news brief for today. Which story impacts you most? Let us know in the comments. And hit follow for tomorrow's AI news.

description: Today's AI news dives into Microsoft's significant layoffs, sparking fears of AI replacing jobs. We also uncover a secret Claude tracker that shocked users. Plus, the NHS accelerates its AI rollout, and the UK financial regulator issues an AI "arms race" warning.
